comment: The panel labels HPF and LPF are on the wrong filters: the knob printed HPF is HIGH_CUT_PARAM, 1kHz to 20kHz, set as a low-pass (src/ChanIn.cpp:1003, 1731, label at 1585, ChanInFilters::updateFiltersIfChanged AeLOWPASS), and the knob printed LPF is LOW_CUT_PARAM, 20Hz to 500Hz, set as a high-pass. The README describes the two ranges correctly and never connects them to the panel lettering. The filters are bypassed entirely while the high cut is at 20kHz and the low cut at 20Hz, which are the defaults, so the module starts as gain and phase only. DISPLAY_ENABLE_PARAM has no ParamWidget and cannot be clicked for help; it is toggled by a custom square drawn at 96,43.
